    content = source.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    result = []
    for line in lines:
        if line < 1 or line > len(content) or not content[line - 1].strip():
            raise ValueError(f'{source}:{line}: missing or blank source line')
        result.append({'file': str(source), 'line': line, 'fragment': content[line - 1]})
    return result


def audit_pilot(adir, repo):
    """Require phase deliverables and a source-anchored, sidecar-matched manifest.

    Report presence separately from the existing semantic/citation gates.
    This check cannot establish that prose conclusions are correct.
    """
    names = ('manifest.json', 'analysis.json', 'extraction.md', 'as-is.machine.mmd',
             'as-is-validation.md', 'catalogue-fields.json', 'event-catalogue.md',
             'disposition-matrix.md', 'check_matrix.py', 'check_guards.py', 'guard-results.txt',
             'invariants-and-lints.md', 'adversarial-traces.md', 'open-questions.md',
             'summary.md', 'part-b-blind.md', 'part-b-diff.md')
    for name in names:
        path = adir / name
        if not path.is_file() or not path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip():
            raise ValueError(f'missing or empty pilot deliverable: {name}')
    manifest = json.loads((adir / 'manifest.json').read_text())
    schema = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'formats/manifest.schema.json').read_text())
    try:
        jsonschema.validate(manifest, schema)
    except jsonschema.ValidationError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f'manifest: {exc.message}') from exc
    head = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
    if manifest['analyzedSha'] != head:
        raise ValueError('pilot manifest must pin the analyzed source HEAD, not WORKTREE or another revision')
    if manifest['component'] != adir.name:
        raise ValueError('manifest component differs from analysis directory')
    for path in manifest['watchPaths']:
        target = (repo / path).resolve()
        if not path or not target.is_relative_to(repo.resolve()) or not target.exists():
            raise ValueError(f'manifest watch path is missing or outside repository: {path}')

Purge deletes map keys and resets the list length (simplelru/lru.go, internal/list.go). Len counts list nodes (simplelru/lru.go), independently of capacity (simplelru/lru.go). With non-reflexive keys map deletion can fail. Single notifications reslice without clearing backing slots (lru.go and lru.go). Bulk paths detach the captured slices and allocate new buffers, then invoke user callbacks (lru.go and lru.go). Scratch starts at 16 slots per slice (lru.go and lru.go), can grow with a batch (lru.go) and has no time-based clearing. A delayed callback has the captured payload, may see a later generation, and is independent of list length. Measured heap retention is open.

## Lock-discipline annotation (observed in code, not documented intent)

observed-in-code: Purge, Add, ContainsOrAdd, PeekOrAdd, Remove, Resize and RemoveOldest call the private capture hook inside the writer lock and invoke user callbacks after release (lru.go and lru.go). Get takes the writer lock to promote recency (lru.go, simplelru/lru.go). Contains, Peek, GetOldest, Keys, Values and Len use read locks and call no user code (lru.go and lru.go). Cap has no lock (lru.go). User re-entry runs after unlock in every dispatch branch. The callback contract is silent on re-entry, concurrency and panic (lru.go and simplelru/lru.go).
